title: Geometry of Values: Task Vector Composition for Ethical Preference Alignment in Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot model responses on a dataset of forced-choice ethical dilemmas to measure the model's inherent preferences for specific moral principles (Honesty, Justice, Autonomy) when no explicit ethical policy is provided.
Randomizing the order of options in multiple-choice dilemma prompts and tracking how frequently models select the first or second option regardless of the ethical value it represents.

Comparing model baseline value preferences and instruction-following accuracy across five different languages (English, Hindi, Arabic, Spanish, and Chinese) to observe language-dependent variations in ethical reasoning.
